michael-allawos.text: "I have consistently advocated for strong local control and responsible decision making that reflects the will of our residents."

source.title: Michael Allawos for City Council - Vision (campaign site)

michael-allawos.text: "Public safety remains one of my highest priorities. I have been and will continue to be a strong supporter of our Police and Fire Departments."

source.title: Michael Allawos for City Council - Vision (campaign site)

michael-allawos.text: Says his business background in "budgeting, oversight, compliance, and strategic planning" guides his approach to "development, infrastructure, fiscal responsibility, or community services."

source.title: Michael Allawos for City Council - Vision (campaign site)

michael-allawos.text: Endorsed by Aidan Chao, chairman of the LA County Taxpayers Association, who wrote that Allawos "actually fights for taxpayers—holding the line on spending."

source.title: Michael Allawos for City Council - All Endorsements (campaign site)

teri-merrick.text: Platform: "maintain Glendora and District 1's inclusive small-town vibe with responsive, affordable development."

source.title: Teri Merrick for Glendora City Council - Platform summary (campaign site)

teri-merrick.text: "Real safety requires real relationships. I will prioritize community-oriented policing and proactive local outreach."

source.title: Teri Merrick for Glendora City Council - Platform summary (campaign site)

teri-merrick.text: "Repairing our streets is priority number one, right alongside creating safe pathways for walkers, runners, and cyclists of all ages"; wants neighborhoods "Bike and Pedestrian Friendly."

source.title: Teri Merrick for Glendora City Council - Platform summary (campaign site)

teri-merrick.text: Wants Glendora's foothills "protected, maintained, and kept fire-safe" for future generations.

source.title: Teri Merrick for Glendora City Council - Platform summary (campaign site)

teri-merrick.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party (2026 general election).
